page.overview:
Who is Divebomb TFP?

Rejecting the credo of his fellow Predacons, Divebomb has opted instead to join the Autobots and take up their cause. He now hunts his fellow Predacons with the same zeal with which they hunt others, and though he shares their lust for destruction, at least now it is harnessed in a more productive way.
